description: 令和6年能登半島地震 能登東部微地形表現図データ(発災前) [earthquakes] is a dataset listed in G-spatial Information Center (G空間情報センター), Japan, an open data portal, published or maintained by 令和6年能登半島地震. 石川県が実施した「令和4年度 森林情報整備業務」で取得した、 発災前の能登東部の微地形表現図「CS立体図」画像データ（TIF, TFW） です。 上記の計測範囲図は、航空レーザ測量ポータルサイト（公益財団法人日本測量調査技術協会）から引用しています。 提供データの整備範囲と一致しない場合は、提供データを正とさせていただきます。 ダ... Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 令和6年能登半島地震. Its tags are CS立体図, 令和6年能登半島地震, 微地形表現図, 能登東部. It offers 3 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2026-02-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is the data owner's own terms of use (see the dataset page). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-gsi-portal.
